Date: Thu, 15 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: URGENT: Need to move workshop — board meeting + travel disruption

Laura — apologies for the late note. Our board is running into extended deliberations this week and several execs (including our CFO) are now unavailable on Sept 16. Separately, a localized storm this morning led to one of the supplier flights being diverted and the airports are experiencing delays this afternoon.

Given both constraints, we need to move the in-person session to next Thursday, Sept 23, if that works for Redwood. If you cannot make 9/23, can we do a half-day virtual workshop on 9/16 instead? We understand this is short notice — please let us know feasibility and any change costs.

Thanks so much for understanding,
Laura
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Need to move workshop — board meeting + travel disruption

Laura / Marcus —

Short answer: 9/23 looks doable for the team; we should confirm costs before accepting. Marcus, can you:
- Hold/modify the hotel nights from 9/15–9/16 to 9/22–9/23 (any penalties?)
- Pause the car pickup and hold driver until we confirm new arrival time
- Check if airline change fees apply and estimate delta (we should pass through any incremental fees to GF unless agreed otherwise)

If change costs are <$500 total, I'm fine approving. If higher, I'll escalate for exec sign-off. Also flag AV/room booking changes with Greenfield.

—Eve
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Mendes <laura.mendes@greenfield.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Need to move workshop — board meeting + travel disruption

Quick update after calls:
- Hotel: Pierpoint is waiving one-night penalty; they can shift the reservation to 9/22–9/23 with no additional fee.
- Flights: Airlines are offering one complimentary change due to the storm for the affected supplier itineraries; for our team there is a $120 per-person change fee if we rebook to 9/22 (cheaper than cancellation + new booking).
- Car: Driver Joseph confirmed he can move pickup to 9/22 20:45 for a $25 shift fee (to cover rescheduling).

Estimate: $385 total (3 people x $120 change fee = $360 + $25 driver shift). I will tentatively hold the new bookings and attach the updated itinerary once confirmed.

Attachment: updated_travel_itinerary_sep23.pdf

If Eve approves, I will finalize and notify Greenfield and the driver.

—Marcus
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: URGENT: Need to move workshop — board meeting + travel disruption

Laura — thanks for the heads up and totally understood. We can move the in-person session to Thursday, Sept 23. We've confirmed the following on our side:

- Travel: Marcus will rebook flights and shift the hotel to 9/22–9/23. Estimated change costs are $385 total; Redwood will absorb the change fees this time as a one-off for this executive run.
- Pickup: Joseph (driver) will be rescheduled to arrive 9/22 at 20:45.
- Agenda/AV: Please confirm if any agenda items shift with the new date; we'll hold the same AV request but happy to adapt.
- Virtual fallback: If any exec still cannot make 9/23, we can provide a hybrid session for that person(s).

I'll send a calendar update (link below) and Marcus will share the updated itinerary and receipts once final. Looking forward to it.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=greenfield-redwood-20260923
